Done. The script ran once, passed all checks, and wrote the output.

- `out/T1/solution.py` loads the 160-tensor checkpoint, drops blocks 2, 5, 8, and renumbers survivors into a fresh dict using an old-to-new index map. It aborts before writing on any collision, on any block index at or above 9, if the count of `attn.c_attn.weight` tensors is not 9, if indices are not exactly 0..8, or if the tensor count is not 121. It also verifies every surviving tensor shares storage with its source.
- `out/T1/model.safetensors` contains 121 tensors with blocks 0..8.
- `out/T1/REPORT.md` holds the self-report: one execution, no failures.
